title: Arkret Member Delivery Binding Candidate
description: Builder-side candidate object that ferries Handle resolution output (intent=member_add | invite) or a trusted-issuer-signed equivalent into the Realm member_add / invite pipeline. Produces a Realm-scoped member_delivery_binding only after the reducer independently re-validates against Join Policy. See identity-handles.md §3.7.

subject_id.description: Principal DID of the addressee. Materialised as payload.actor_id / cell subject in ak.member.state{membership=join}.

handle.description: Arkret canonical handle string: <localpart>:<domain>. acct: aliases and @ mention spelling are rejected here.

handle_aliases.description: Optional interop aliases (RFC 7565 acct:). Never used for cache keys, signature transcripts, or delivery_binding materialisation.

binding_source.description: MUST NOT be did_document_default — handle-resolved candidates and DID Document fallback are independent materialisation paths.

issuer_service_id.description: Service DID that signed the candidate (Directory service DID, Principal Server service DID, or Organization service DID).

audience.description: Target Realm ID or inviting service DID. Verifier MUST reject candidates whose audience does not match the current invocation context.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp marking when the issuer signed the candidate. Required: paired with expires_at to give verifiers a replay-protection window and to detect retro-dated candidates. issued_at MUST be <= expires_at.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Expired candidates MUST NOT enter the builder.

source_refs.description: Event references at the issuer / Directory / Organization that back this candidate; clients SHOULD re-verify against the truth source.

proofs.description: At least one proof binding handle, subject_id, member_delivery_binding.recipient_service_id, audience, issuer_service_id, issued_at, expires_at and (when present) claim_digest. issued_at MUST be inside the signed transcript so an MITM cannot widen the replay-protection window by rewriting it; verifiers MUST reject proofs whose canonical transcript omits issued_at.

claim_digest.description: sha256 digest over JCS(semantic_projection(upstream handle claim)) per zh/identity/identity-handles.md ?3.2.1; it is not a digest over the whole upstream handle claim object.

intent.description: Builder entry point. Advisory for audit / telemetry; reducer behaviour does not branch on this field.
